statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is directly mapped from the 'Depreciation and amortization' line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income...' section of the operating activities. The supplementary tables contain detailed lease information (Note 18) and parent company cash flows (Note 33), but these do not provide additional breakdowns of the consolidated depreciation and amortization figure itself. Therefore, only the single, consolidated value from the primary statement is used for each period.
